surprises.description: Adjusted EPS was $2.12, above the preview’s $1.89 consensus and its own $1.64–$1.75 estimate. That was a meaningful beat even against the preview’s higher-end bull scenario of $1.95–$2.10.
surprises.fact_evidence: “Adjusted EPS was $2.12” and exceeded consensus estimates.
surprises.expectation_evidence: “EPS | $1.89” consensus; “My build (adjusted) | ~$1.64–1.75”; bull scenario adjusted EPS of “$1.95–2.10.”

surprises.description: GAAP results were far better than the preview’s forecast of near-zero or negative EPS: the company reported $1.57 per diluted share. The call cited $8.9 million of pretax merger expenses, rather than the preview’s expectation that more than $20 million after tax of restructuring costs would land in the quarter.
surprises.fact_evidence: “GAAP net income was $17.5 million ($1.57 per diluted share)” after excluding “$8.9 million pretax merger expenses” and $938,000 of discrete tax benefits for the adjusted calculation.
surprises.expectation_evidence: “The bulk — call it $20M+ after-tax — should land in Q3” and “GAAP EPS could print near zero or negative.”

surprises.description: Net interest margin substantially exceeded the preview’s expected 540–545 bps day-one level: reported NIM was 574 bps and about 568 bps normalized for a full Signature quarter. The 2027 outlook of 570–575 bps was also well above the originally projected high-540s/low-550s range.
surprises.fact_evidence: “Net interest margin was 5.74% (normalized to ~5.68% for a full quarter of Signature),” with guidance for “a stable 5.70%-5.75% for 2027,” well above the originally projected high-540s/low-550s range.
surprises.expectation_evidence: Management guided explicitly to “540–545bps day one”; the preview also says the original projection was in the “high-540s/low-550s range.”

surprises.description: Organic litigation loan growth was much faster than the preview’s 20%+ annualized benchmark: the call reported $160 million of organic growth, or 49% annualized. Total organic loans were up 32% year over year.
surprises.fact_evidence: Loans included “$160 million of organic litigation loan growth (49% annualized)”; year-over-year organic loan growth was “$497 million or 32%.”
surprises.expectation_evidence: The litigation loan growth benchmark was “+20%+ annualized.”

surprises.description: Management provided a specific 2027 EPS target despite the preview expecting no formal EPS guidance, and said it expects to exceed the earnings expectations set when the deal was announced.
surprises.fact_evidence: Management guided to “approximately $9 per share in diluted EPS for 2027” and expects “to exceed the earnings expectations set when the deal was announced on March 12, 2026.”
surprises.expectation_evidence: “ESQ does not give formal EPS guidance, so the call is the only venue.”

surprises.description: The adjusted efficiency ratio was far better than the preview’s expected low-to-mid-50s combined-company range, coming in at 41.1%.
surprises.expectation_evidence: The preview said to “expect low-to-mid 50s” for the combined efficiency ratio.
